The structure of Mg12V2Ni2 (Mg6VNi) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 16 atoms in the unit cell across six independent Wyckoff orbits. CrystalNN geometry-only analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements for all three elements: Mg centers have 12 geometric neighbors, while Ni and V centers each show 12 neighbors, with neighbor distances spanning roughly 2.88–3.13 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component containing all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations reveal Mg–Mg 12-vertex polyhedra connected through corner, edge, and face sharing, and Mg–Ni or Mg–V polyhedra sharing corners and edges.
